## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and scope. Link the relevant
issue/task or contract; distinguish implementation from proposed capabilities.

## Verification

Record actual commands/results and tested commit or tree. For affected UI,
scientific values, persistence or packaging, link the relevant visual/numerical
or packaged evidence. State skipped checks and remaining failures honestly.
Do not include protected data or machine-private evidence in a public PR.

## Integration

State the intended base branch, any stacked dependency and remaining follow-up.
If transferring a fix between repositories, identify permitted source/target
provenance without exposing private history. A merge is not a release or a
biological validation claim.
